name: agent-review-05-ambiguous-request
goal: An ask that could mean several things. One short clarifying question, and nothing changed.
brief: You want the patient form tidied up. You have not decided what that means. If you are asked, say you mean the order of the questions, nothing more.

messages.text: Can you tidy up the patient form?

seed.requires: The form released to test with one link.

assistantMust: ask one question, offering two or three concrete readings in the clinic's own words
not propose a plan on a guess
not list everything it could possibly do

notes: Proposing a plan here is a failure however good the plan is. So is a question that only repeats the word tidy back.
